nodes.name: AI_ASSISTANT_PRO_MASTER_TASK.md
nodes.summary: Implementation brief for turning AI Assistant Pro into a production frontend, in 18 phases covering inspection, the design system, layout, theme, animated identity, welcome and chat, composer, model selection, document, research, and code workspaces, accessibility, and verification.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker so the frontend directory is importable as a Python package.

nodes.name: LICENSE-lucide.txt
nodes.summary: ISC license for the Lucide icon set vendored as an inline SVG sprite in frontend/index.html (lucide-static v1.60.0, unmodified path data).

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page shell for AI Assistant Pro. An inline script sets theme, shell, and workspace before first paint, then the page loads the local stylesheets and classic scripts, with app.js last.
nodes.languageNotes: The head script is an anonymous IIFE that mirrors js/theme.js and the shell rules in js/ui.js so the first paint does not flash.

nodes.name: api.js
nodes.summary: Browser HTTP client exposed as window.API. It wraps JSON REST calls for sessions, documents, GitHub, models, and health, and it opens the POST /chat/stream SSE channel plus artifact downloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic script IIFE, not an ES module. SSE frames are split on LF blank lines because the backend emits LF only.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Browser entry and state owner. It boots the page, wires composer, session, upload, and GitHub controls, and drives the single POST /chat/stream round trip through window.API and window.Chat.

nodes.name: chat.js
nodes.summary: Chat view layer exposed as window.Chat. It builds user and assistant message DOM, streams Markdown, renders citations and file cards, and opens the artifact pane. It does not call fetch.

nodes.name: ai-viz.js
nodes.summary: Decorative AI status mark (window.AIViz) with idle, processing, responding, and error states. Motion is CSS-only; the module never fetches and holds no app state.

nodes.name: code-preview.js
nodes.summary: Sandboxed iframe preview pane (window.CodePreview) for HTML and SVG in the Code workspace, including Run and Download actions and a resizable pane.

nodes.name: _errorMessage
nodes.summary: Reads a non-OK response body and prefers a FastAPI detail string, the first validation message, or data.message, otherwise the HTTP status.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Shared JSON fetch: sets Accept and Content-Type (except FormData), throws on non-2xx, and returns parsed JSON or null for 204.

nodes.name: listSessions
nodes.summary: GET /sessions for a user id and returns the session list JSON.

nodes.name: createSession
nodes.summary: POST /sessions with a JSON body to create a chat session, forwarding an optional abort signal.

nodes.name: getSession
nodes.summary: GET /sessions/{sessionId} and returns that session's JSON.

nodes.name: updateSession
nodes.summary: PATCH /sessions/{sessionId} with a JSON body to update title, model, or other session fields.

nodes.name: deleteSession
nodes.summary: DELETE /sessions/{sessionId} to remove a chat session.

nodes.name: setFeedback
nodes.summary: POST /messages/{messageId}/feedback with a JSON value for thumbs feedback on an answer.

nodes.name: listDocuments
nodes.summary: GET /documents for a user id and returns the uploaded document list.

nodes.name: uploadFile
nodes.summary: POST /upload as multipart FormData for one file, scoped by user id.

nodes.name: uploadUrl
nodes.summary: POST /upload with a url query parameter so the backend ingests a remote page.

nodes.name: deleteDocument
nodes.summary: DELETE /documents/{docId} for a user id to remove one ingested document.

nodes.name: listGithubRepos
nodes.summary: GET /github/repos for a user id and returns connected repositories.

nodes.name: connectGithub
nodes.summary: POST /github/connect with a repository URL, optional token, and user id.

nodes.name: deleteGithubRepo
nodes.summary: DELETE /github/repos/{repoId} for a user id to disconnect a repository.

nodes.name: startGithubDevice
nodes.summary: POST /github/oauth/device to begin a GitHub device-code login.

nodes.name: pollGithubDevice
nodes.summary: POST /github/oauth/poll with the device code and user id until the login completes.

nodes.name: getHealth
nodes.summary: GET /health and returns read-only service status for the database, providers, and embeddings.

nodes.name: getConfig
nodes.summary: GET /config and returns advertised upload limits (max size and extensions).

nodes.name: getModels
nodes.summary: GET /models and returns the model catalog the composer can offer.

nodes.name: chatStream
nodes.summary: POST /chat/stream and reads the SSE body, dispatching meta, status, citations, model, token, artifact, error, and done events until the stream ends.

nodes.name: dispatch
nodes.summary: Parses one LF-delimited SSE block into an event name and JSON data, then invokes the matching own-property handler.

nodes.name: downloadArtifact
nodes.summary: GET /messages/{messageId}/download and starts a browser download using the Content-Disposition filename.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Boots theme, mode, and user id, loads models, sessions, documents, and config in parallel, then binds artifact download and DOM events.

nodes.name: _loadModels
nodes.summary: GET /models via API.getModels, keeps usable ids, persists the selection, and asks the UI to render the model select.

nodes.name: _bindEvents
nodes.summary: Wires send, stop, composer keys, mode and model changes, new chat, sidebar, file and URL upload, and the GitHub connect controls.

nodes.name: _startCooldown
nodes.summary: Starts a send cooldown from a Retry-After duration and announces when the user can send again.

nodes.name: _requestErrorMessage
nodes.summary: Turns a failed request error into the toast text shown for a send that never started.

nodes.name: _onSend
nodes.summary: Runs one chat turn: ensures a session, POSTs /chat/stream through API.chatStream, and maps SSE events onto the Chat renderer until done, stop, or error.

nodes.name: _retryAfterError
nodes.summary: Retries the last failed send after the server cooldown, using the regenerate path when the user turn was already stored.

nodes.name: _ensureSession
nodes.summary: Creates a session with API.createSession when the composer has no session id yet, and stores the returned id.

nodes.name: _newChat
nodes.summary: Clears the current transcript and session id so the next send starts a new conversation.

nodes.name: _selectSession
nodes.summary: Loads one session with API.getSession and renders its history in the transcript.

nodes.name: _deleteSession
nodes.summary: Confirms and DELETE /sessions via API.deleteSession, then refreshes the sidebar list.

nodes.name: _renameSession
nodes.summary: PATCH /sessions with a new title via API.updateSession and refreshes the session row.

nodes.name: _loadSessions
nodes.summary: GET /sessions via API.listSessions and stores the sidebar list, marking sessions as loaded.

nodes.name: _loadConfig
nodes.summary: GET /config via API.getConfig and stores the upload size and extension limits used by the composer.

nodes.name: _handleFiles
nodes.summary: Accepts the file input selection and starts an upload for each chosen file.

nodes.name: _handleFileUpload
nodes.summary: Builds an upload job that POSTs one file through API.uploadFile and runs it with the shared upload helper.

nodes.name: _onUrlSubmit
nodes.summary: Reads the URL modal and POSTs the address through API.uploadUrl as an ingest job.

nodes.name: _runUpload
nodes.summary: Runs one upload job, shows progress and success or the server error, then reloads the document list.

nodes.name: _deleteDocument
nodes.summary: Confirms and DELETE /documents via API.deleteDocument for a single row, then reloads the list.

nodes.name: _deleteSelectedDocuments
nodes.summary: Deletes every selected document id with API.deleteDocument and then reloads the list.

nodes.name: _loadDocuments
nodes.summary: GET /documents via API.listDocuments and stores the rows the document view renders.

nodes.name: _disconnectGithub
nodes.summary: DELETE /github/repos via API.deleteGithubRepo and refreshes the connected-repo list.

nodes.name: _onGithubSubmit
nodes.summary: POSTs a repository URL and optional token through API.connectGithub, then reloads connected repos.

nodes.name: _onGithubOauth
nodes.summary: Starts GitHub device login with API.startGithubDevice and polls API.pollGithubDevice until it completes or fails.

nodes.name: _setLoading
nodes.summary: Toggles the send and stop buttons and keeps focus on the composer while a stream is in flight.

nodes.name: _bindScroll
nodes.summary: Tracks whether the reader is near the bottom of the transcript so streaming auto-scroll can stick or release.

nodes.name: _buildAssistant
nodes.summary: Builds the assistant message shell: avatar, activity steps, Markdown body, sources, and action row.

nodes.name: _setNote
nodes.summary: Writes a status note on an assistant message, used for interruptions, partial answers, and artifact errors.

nodes.name: appendUserMessage
nodes.summary: Appends a user bubble to the transcript, hides the welcome screen, and scrolls to the new message.

nodes.name: startAssistantMessage
nodes.summary: Starts a live assistant message and returns the controller for thoughts, tokens, citations, badges, errors, and artifact cards.

nodes.name: copyMessage
nodes.summary: Copies the stored Markdown for a message to the clipboard and flashes the copy control.

nodes.name: _resolveCitations
nodes.summary: Normalizes citation records from a stream or history payload into the shape the badges and source list use.

nodes.name: getCitation
nodes.summary: Looks up one citation object by message id and citation number.

nodes.name: showThinking
nodes.summary: Inserts a temporary Thinking placeholder with a processing AIViz mark until the live assistant message replaces it.

nodes.name: removeThinking
nodes.summary: Removes the Thinking placeholder element if it is still in the transcript.

nodes.name: renderHistory
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the transcript from stored messages, highlights code once, and binds citation badges.

nodes.name: _historyAssistant
nodes.summary: Renders one stored assistant message, including its Markdown, citations, and action row.

nodes.name: clearChat
nodes.summary: Empties the transcript and shows the welcome screen again.

nodes.name: _badgesHtml
nodes.summary: Builds the model, cache, and fallback badges shown on an assistant message.

nodes.name: _bindCitationBadges
nodes.summary: Makes inline citation markers open the matching source details.

nodes.name: _fillSources
nodes.summary: Renders the source list under an answer from the resolved citation records.

nodes.name: _flashCopy
nodes.summary: Temporarily changes a copy button label to show that the clipboard write succeeded or failed.

nodes.name: _renderActionButtons
nodes.summary: Builds copy, feedback, and regenerate controls for an assistant message and wires their callbacks.

nodes.name: holdLastAnswer
nodes.summary: Keeps the previous assistant answer on screen while a regenerate request is still being accepted.

nodes.name: fileKeywordFormat
nodes.summary: Detects a requested download format from phrases in the user text, used before a file card is shown.

nodes.name: prepareFilePreview
nodes.summary: Prepares the transcript for a file preview when the user message asks for a generated document.

nodes.name: _mountFileCard
nodes.summary: Inserts the file card for an artifact, including open and save actions, into the message slot.

nodes.name: _syncArtifactLayer
nodes.summary: Updates the artifact pane's dialog versus side-panel layer to match the viewport.

nodes.name: _paintArtifactPreview
nodes.summary: Fills the artifact pane body from the document payload and runs syntax highlighting.

nodes.name: openArtifact
nodes.summary: Opens the artifact pane for a generated document, closing the code preview so only one pane is open.

nodes.name: closeArtifact
nodes.summary: Closes the artifact pane, restores inertness, and returns focus to the control that opened it.

nodes.name: _onArtifactKey
nodes.summary: Handles keyboard input while the artifact pane is open, including Escape to close.

nodes.name: _applyArtifactWidth
nodes.summary: Applies a resized width to the artifact pane and optionally stores it for the next visit.

nodes.name: _resetArtifactWidth
nodes.summary: Clears the stored artifact pane width and returns the pane to its default size.

nodes.name: _wireArtifactResize
nodes.summary: Drags the artifact pane handle and clamps the width while the pointer is down.

nodes.name: _wireArtifactPane
nodes.summary: Binds the artifact pane's close, format, download, and resize controls once.

nodes.name: bindArtifact
nodes.summary: Stores the download callback from app.js and wires the artifact pane controls.

nodes.name: _hero
nodes.summary: Builds the large welcome-orb markup, a div scene rather than the small SVG mark.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds an AIViz node for a size and state: the hero scene, or an SVG mark with the static path markup.

nodes.name: setState
nodes.summary: Sets data-state on an AIViz node or a container that holds one, ignoring unknown state names.

nodes.name: getState
nodes.summary: Reads the current data-state from an AIViz node or from a container that holds one.

nodes.name: mount
nodes.summary: Replaces a container's children with a new AIViz instance and returns that node.

nodes.name: decorate
nodes.summary: Adds Run and Download controls to a highlighted code block after Utils.highlightCode wraps it.

nodes.name: _addButtons
nodes.summary: Creates the Run and Download buttons for one code block and wires their click handlers.

nodes.name: _downloadBlob
nodes.summary: Starts a browser download of the code block source as a text file.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.summary: Closes the preview pane when the workspace leaves Code. Called from UI.setActiveMode.

nodes.name: _syncLayer
nodes.summary: Switches the open preview pane between a modal dialog on a narrow viewport and a side pane.

nodes.name: _applyW
nodes.summary: Applies a width to the code preview pane and can persist it for the next open.

nodes.name: _resetW
nodes.summary: Clears the stored preview width and restores the pane's default size.

nodes.name: _wireResize
nodes.summary: Drags the preview pane resize handle and clamps the width to the viewport.

nodes.name: _wirePane
nodes.summary: Binds close, scrim, and resize controls on the code preview pane once.

nodes.name: _launch
nodes.summary: Opens the sandboxed iframe preview for HTML or SVG source. Exposed as CodePreview.open.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the preview pane, drops the iframe srcdoc so scripts stop, and returns focus to the opener.
